description: A JavaScript module defining a Lightning JS component named 'RecipeCard'. The component renders a recipe card UI with image, title, tags, time, and favorite toggle, and emits events on user interactions.

methods.name: $onToggle
methods.description: Emits 'toggleFavorite' event with the current recipe ID to toggle the favorite state.

methods.name: $onOpen
methods.description: Emits 'open' event with the current recipe ID to show recipe details.
